name: Yacht Club at The Boca Raton
positioning: Adults-only, all-suite hotel within The Boca Raton, set beside a yacht-lined marina on the Intracoastal Waterway
best_for: Couples and adults wanting a waterfront suite with a balcony and butler service

facts.text: Yacht Club sits beside a yacht-lined marina.
Yacht Club guests have access to the private amenities of The Boca Raton Club.
Yacht Club guests can use a water taxi service.
Yacht Club guests have access to a fleet of bicycles.
Yacht Club is dog-friendly, for dogs up to 35 pounds.
Suites include a complimentary minibar and snacks.
Suites have Molton Brown bath amenities.
Suites have a Nespresso coffee maker.
Yacht Club guests receive a complimentary European continental breakfast.
At Flybridge, dishes are prepared a few feet from the tables in a glass-enclosed kitchen.

highlights.text: Every suite has a balcony overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway.
Yacht Club guests have use of the pool at Spa Palmera.
Yacht Club offers personal butler service.

Guests in the Yacht Club Suite Collection get access to Top of the Tower, a private 27th-floor lounge with views of the Atlantic Ocean, from 1:00 to 7:00 pm, with complimentary lunch and dinner bites and drinks.
Flybridge, the fine-dining restaurant perched atop Yacht Club, is exclusive to Yacht Club guests and Club members.

considerations.text: Yacht Club is adults only, with no children under 16.
Flybridge requires reservations and evening attire.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects its exclusive yacht club positioning.
